Class RegionalRasterBenchmarkExtractor

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.RegionalRasterBenchmarkExtractor
public final class RegionalRasterBenchmarkExtractor extends Object
Extracts true regional empirical ground-truth trajectories inside windowed geographic bounds [minLat, maxLat, minLng, maxLng] directly from 2D conserved spherical rasters (HYDE 3.4 population counts popc_*.asc and land-use archives *_lu.zip).

Eliminates the legacy static global-to-regional extensive ratio approximation by integrating physical empirical grid cells directly inside the simulated spatial domain.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

      Sums conserved regional population inside [minLat, maxLat, minLng, maxLng] directly from a conserved count raster indexed [height][width].

      public static Map<Integer,Double> extractRegionalSeries(String benchKey, double[] windowBounds, Collection<Integer> sampleYears)
      Extracts and linearly/monotonically interpolates a true regional empirical benchmark series across sampleYears from locally present 2D HYDE 3.4 rasters.
      Parameters:
